typography.font_family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

navbar.notes: navy-900 top bar, 64px tall, 2px brand-red bottom border; navbar__brand (app icon + 'StockFlow') left, navbar__links right; active link uses --color-brand. data-testid='navbar'.

page.notes: warm-oat --color-surface background, centered 960px column (--space-6 --space-4 padding); page__header holds page__title (page__title-icon warehouse mark + name).

card.notes: white --color-card surface, --radius-lg, navy-tinted --shadow-sm, --space-5 padding; hosts the stock table and detail panels.

button.variants: btn--primary (solid --color-brand, sharp --radius-sharp 0px corners, Receive/Pick/Save/Submit), btn--secondary (outlined navy), btn--ghost (text-only). Min tap target 44x44px.
button.notes: hover --color-brand-hover; brand red for primary/active only.

form_input.notes: field__label persistent visible label (never placeholder-only), --radius-sm, focus ring --color-info; field__error shows inline next to the field naming it, data-testid='field-error'.

table.notes: cool uppercase --text-xs header row (stock-table__head); numeric cells right-aligned in --font-mono with tabular-nums; calm high-contrast rows for scanning.

status_badge.variants: badge--in-stock (--color-success, 'in stock'), badge--low (--color-warning, 'low'), badge--out (--color-error, 'out'), badge--on-order (--color-info, 'on order'), badge--quarantined (--color-navy-500, 'quarantined')
status_badge.notes: pill --radius-pill, --text-xs uppercase; state carried by BOTH text and color/shape, never color alone.

empty_state.notes: line icon + teaching heading + guiding copy + a CTA (e.g. 'No stock at this location, receive an inbound shipment'); also renders 'not tracked' for SKUs without batch/serial detail. Never a blank region. data-testid='empty-state'.

toast.notes: fixed top-right, role='alert'/aria-live; feedback never shifts page layout. data-testid='toast'.

scan_zone.notes: primary barcode input on the floor; success -> green flash + stock row updates in place (scan-zone--ok), failure (unknown/locked) -> red flash (scan-zone--error) + persistent error toast. data-testid='scan-zone'.

app_icon.notes: warehouse mark from client/src/assets/warehouse.png; shown in navbar__brand and page__title (28px). Favicon variant wired in index.html for the browser tab.
